lines.en: label halloween1:
scene firsthalloweenevent1
I’m relaxing in my room after a long and uneventful day at[school].
lines.zh: 在[school]度过了漫长又平淡的一天后，我正在房间里放松。

lines.en: Well, maybe not entirely uneventful.
lines.zh: 好吧，也许也不完全是平淡无奇。

lines.en: Molly took it upon herself to start hosting some impromptu game show since nothing else was going on.
lines.zh: 因为实在没什么事可做，Molly 自作主张办起了一场即兴的综艺游戏节目。

lines.en: It pretty much ruined any chance I had of sleeping through the post-lunch part of the day so, believe it or not, I’m in a pretty sour mood right now.
lines.zh: 这基本上彻底毁掉了我把午后的时间睡过去的可能性，所以信不信由你，我现在心情相当糟糕。

lines.en: Now, I know what you’re thinking-
lines.zh: 现在，我知道你在想什么——

lines.en: That I’m typically so full of life and am essentially the beacon of what a self-sufficient adult male should be.
lines.zh: ——我平时总是充满活力，简直就是自给自足的成年男性该有的那盏明灯。

lines.en: But I assure you-
lines.zh: 但我向你保证——

lines.en: Right now, there isn’t anything that could possibly make me feel any better.
lines.zh: 此刻，没有任何东西能让我心情变好一点。

lines.en: : Hi! Coming in now!
lines.zh: : 嗨！我进来啦！

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent2
: Good evening, Sensei. How would you like to see all of us in costumes?
lines.zh: : 晚上好，Sensei。你想不想看我们所有人穿上万圣节装扮？

lines.en: Never mind. Life is good again.
lines.zh: 当我没说。生活又美好了。

lines.en: : Yes, please.
lines.zh: : 想，非常想。

lines.en: : You’re supposed to wait until {i}after{/i} someone responds to the knock to actually go into their room, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你应该等别人回应了敲门声{i}之后{/i}才能进人家的房间，Ayane。

lines.en: : Why doesn’t anyone understand the concept of knocking around here?
lines.zh: : 为什么这地方没人懂“敲门”这个概念？

lines.en: : Ami, don’t you do that exact thing with my office at work all the time?
lines.zh: : Ami，你在上班的地方不是也老这么闯我办公室吗？

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent3
: I have special [niece] privileges! I don’t need to wait for you to answer since I have to make sure you’re okay!
lines.zh: : 我有特殊的[niece]特权！我得确认你没事，所以不需要等你回答！

lines.en: : Why would I be in distress in my own office?
lines.zh: : 我在自己的办公室里能出什么事？

lines.en: : Because I said so!
lines.zh: : 因为我说了算！

lines.en: : Umm...I don’t really think I should...be in here...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我真的觉得我……不该待在这儿……

lines.en: : It feels a little...early...
lines.zh: : 感觉有点……太早了……

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent4
: Oh, stop. You’re in good hands.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。你在我手里很安全。

lines.en: : Besides, if Sensei tries to do anything lewd to you, I’ll just sacrifice myself in your place so you can continue being pure.
lines.zh: : 再说了，如果 Sensei 想对你做什么下流的事，我就替你牺牲自己，好让你继续保持纯洁。

lines.en: : Umm...
: Thank...you?...
: Sorry to interrupt, but I’m going to need a little more information about you three putting on costumes for me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，不过关于你们三个要穿装扮给我看这件事，我还需要多一点信息。

lines.en: : Since you’re all in my room, I can only assume it's because you want to-
lines.zh: : 既然你们都在我房间里，我只能假设是因为你们想——

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent5
: Halloween party. Ayane’s house. Shopping. Go. Tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 万圣节派对。Ayane 家。逛街。走。明天。

lines.en: : Ayane, translate.
lines.zh: : Ayane，翻译一下。

lines.en: : What she said pretty much covers all of the bases.
lines.zh: : 她说的差不多把该说的都说了。

lines.en: : Sunday is Halloween, and Geoffrey said it’s okay if we throw a party at my place.
lines.zh: : 周日就是万圣节，Geoffrey 说我们可以在我家办派对。

lines.en: : I already know what I’m going as, but Ami and Sana still need to buy a few things to get their costumes ready.
lines.zh: : 我已经想好自己要扮什么了，但 Ami 和 Sana 还得买点东西才能把装扮准备好。

lines.en: : I...don’t even know what I want to be yet...
lines.zh: : 我……连自己想扮什么都还不知道……

lines.en: : So if you have any ideas...
lines.zh: : 所以如果你有什么想法的话……

lines.en: A Halloween costume for Sana?
lines.zh: 给 Sana 挑万圣节装扮？

lines.en: She'd look cute in pretty much anything, so I might as well use this opportunity to put an idea I like quite a bit in her head.
lines.zh: 她穿什么都可爱，那我不如趁这个机会，把我自己挺喜欢的一个点子塞进她脑子里。

lines.en: : Why not some sort of animal? Like...a cat or something?
lines.zh: : 要不要扮成某种动物？比如……猫之类的？

lines.en: I'd also accept a rabbit. Or a dog.
lines.zh: 兔子也行。狗也行。

lines.en: Actually, I’m sure she’ll be adorable in whatever she chooses.
lines.zh: 其实，不管她选什么，肯定都很可爱。

lines.en: I stand by my initial cat-choice, though. Cat-girl Sana is my number-one pick.
lines.zh: 不过我还是坚持最初那个猫的选项。猫娘 Sana 是我的第一选择。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent6
: Oooooh! I want to see you dressed up like an animal too!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦！我也想看你扮成动物！

lines.en: : And then I want to take pictures of you in the dorm and keep them in a special photo-album that I can look at whenever I feel sad!
lines.zh: : 然后我还想在宿舍里给你拍照，收进一本特别的相册里，这样我难过的时候就能拿出来看！

lines.en: : Let’s do it!
lines.zh: : 就这么定了！

lines.en: : Ayane...You’re scaring me again...
lines.zh: : Ayane……你又吓到我了……

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent7
: Wait, does this whole ‘taking you guys shopping’ thing mean I’m going to be spending money? Or is Ayane fronting everything?
lines.zh: : 等等，“带你们去逛街”这件事，是说我要掏钱吗？还是 Ayane 全包？

lines.en: : Oh, I can’t pay for Ami this time.
lines.zh: : 哦，这次我可付不起 Ami 那份。

lines.en: : I actually got into trouble for spending a little over my monthly allowance on the beach trip, so I can’t really buy an extra costume or anything.
lines.zh: : 其实我在海滩旅行的时候超支了一点零用钱，已经被说了，所以实在买不起多一套装扮什么的。

lines.en: : Is that a problem?
lines.zh: : 那有问题吗？

lines.en: : I have some money saved up that I could probably use, but I was hoping to spend that on something a little different.
lines.zh: : 我攒了点钱，大概可以拿出来用，但我本来想把它花在别的东西上。

lines.en: : How about you just...go in your pajamas? You can be a...tired girl for Halloween.
lines.zh: : 要不你就……穿睡衣去？你可以扮成……一个疲惫的女孩过万圣节。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent8
: That’s a horrible idea, even for you.
lines.zh: : 这主意烂透了，即便对你来说也是。

lines.en: : I don’t want to walk around Ayane’s mansion in my pajamas.
lines.zh: : 我可不想穿着睡衣在 Ayane 家的豪宅里走来走去。

lines.en: : You walk around our house in your pajamas all the time.
lines.zh: : 你不是天天穿着睡衣在我们家走来走去吗。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent9
: I’m not walking around a mansion in my pajamas! That is final!
lines.zh: : 我绝对不要穿着睡衣在豪宅里走来走去！就这样，没得商量！

lines.en: : Come to think of it, this will be your first time actually coming over...won't it, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 说起来，这应该是你第一次真正来我家吧……对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Does this mean it’s finally time for you to meet my dad and tell him that we’ll be getting married?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着，你终于要去见我爸爸，然后告诉他我们要结婚了？

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent10
: Does this mean I’ll have to explain to him what happened when the police discover both of your bodies chopped up and placed into dumpsters all around the city?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着，等警察发现你们俩的尸体被切成块、丢进全城各个垃圾桶的时候，我得跟他解释发生了什么？

lines.en: : Oh, right. I told you I’d hold off on hitting on your [uncle] while you’re around. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我说过你在的时候不对你[uncle]发情的。抱歉。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent11
: Not just ‘while I’m around!’ In general! Stop hitting on my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 不只是“我在的时候”！是任何时候！别再对我[uncle]发情了！

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent12
: Umm...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei？……

lines.en: : Have these two always...fought like this?
lines.zh: : 她们两个一直都……这样吵吗？

lines.en: : You’ve known them both for a long time and...it’s a little strange to me how much they yell when they’re...supposedly best friends.
lines.zh: : 你认识她们俩很久了，而且……明明据说是最好的朋友，却吵得那么凶，我有点不太理解。

lines.en: That’s a good question. I wonder how long this rivalry goes back?
lines.zh: 这是个好问题。我很好奇这段对立到底从什么时候开始的？

lines.en: I’m sure it got worse after Ayane and I started having a more...sexual relationship, but I’m pretty sure they’ve had to always kind of be like this, right?
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，在我和 Ayane 开始那种……更肉体的关系之后，情况变得更糟了。但我相当确定，她们大概一直都是这样，对吧？

lines.en: : I stopped keeping track, to be honest. I’ve just accepted it as a part of life.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我早就不数了。我就当它是生活的一部分接受了。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent13
: Hey, that’s exactly what I’ve done with my love for you!
lines.zh: : 嘿，我对你的爱也是这么处理的！

lines.en: : I realized there’s no good way to hide it, so I’ve just added that trait into my personality.
lines.zh: : 我发现根本没办法好好藏住，所以干脆把它当成一个性格特点加进了我的人格里。

lines.en: : Didn’t you literally just tell Ami you’d stop doing this?
lines.zh: : 你不是刚刚才跟 Ami 说你会停下来吗？

lines.en: : Oh, right.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。

lines.en: : This is exactly what I’m talking about, though. I can’t help it.
lines.zh: : 不过这也正是我说的那种情况。我控制不住。

lines.en: : Why are you still here?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么还在这儿？！

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent14
: The same reason you’re here, Ami.
lines.zh: : 跟你在那儿的原因一样啊，Ami。

lines.en: : Because it’ll be getting dark out any minute now and we’re all going to sleep in Sensei’s bed with him tonight.
lines.zh: : 因为天马上就黑了，而我们今晚全都要跟 Sensei 一起睡在他的床上。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : {i}I’m sorry, what?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱歉，你说什么？……{/i}

lines.en: : Isn’t this the perfect opportunity? I obviously wouldn’t have barged in here just to tell him about a party. I could have texted him that.
lines.zh: : 这不是绝佳的机会吗？我显然不会只是为了告诉他有个派对就闯进来。那种事发条短信就行了。

lines.en: : So you barged in here to sleep in his bed?...
lines.zh: : 所以你闯进来是为了睡他的床？……

lines.en: : This is...a joke...right?
lines.zh: : 这是……在开玩笑……对吧？

lines.en: : No one is laughing, so I...don’t really know...
lines.zh: : 可没有人在笑，所以我……真的不知道……

lines.en: : In case anyone wants my opinion, I’m fine with Ayane's idea.
lines.zh: : 如果有人想知道我的意见的话，我没意见，就按 Ayane 说的来。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent15
: Yay! Slumber party!
lines.zh: : 好耶！睡衣派对！

lines.en: : Of course {i}you’re{/i} okay with it! You’re a stupid boy!
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}当然没意见了！你这个蠢男人！

lines.en: : I’m...not okay with it! I don’t even like sleeping with Ayane!
lines.zh: : 我……我可有意见！我连跟 Ayane 一起睡都不喜欢！

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent16
: Oh? Then how come you always squeeze my arm in the middle of the night, Sana?
lines.zh: : 哦？那你为什么半夜总是抱着我的胳膊不放呢，Sana？

lines.en: : Excuse me, but I’d like to inquire about why you two sleep together when you have separate beds.
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，我想问一下，你们俩明明各有各的床，为什么要一起睡？

lines.en: : I’d also like a little more detail about how Sana looks while she is squeezing you and the noises she makes while she sleeps.
lines.zh: : 我还想再详细了解一下：Sana 抱着你的时候是什么样子，还有她睡着时会发出什么声音。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent17
: S-Sensei!
lines.zh: : S——Sensei！

lines.en: : I’m glad you asked, future-husband!
lines.zh: : 很高兴你问这个，未来的丈夫！

lines.en: : She makes these cute little moaning noises whenever she rolls over that make my heart skip a beat even though I don’t like girls.
lines.zh: : 她每次翻身的时候都会发出那种可爱的轻轻呻吟声，让我的心都漏跳一拍——尽管我并不喜欢女生。

lines.en: : They’ve even made me question my love for you on several occasions, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 有好几次，那些声音甚至让我开始怀疑自己对你的爱，Sensei。

lines.en: : You always come out on top, though, so don't worry! I’m sorry for the confusing thoughts about my roommate!
lines.zh: : 不过最后赢的总是你，所以别担心！很抱歉我对室友产生了那种混乱的念头！

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent18
: What confusing thoughts?! This is the first time I’ve heard about any confusing thoughts!
lines.zh: : 什么混乱的念头？！我可是第一次听说有什么混乱的念头！

lines.en: : I don’t like how your eyes look right now, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你现在的眼神，Sensei……

lines.en: : How do they look, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体是什么样的？

lines.en: : They’re filled with desire. Like you’re thinking things you shouldn’t be thinking.
lines.zh: : 里面全是欲望。就好像你在想一些不该想的事情。

lines.en: : Look at me. Only me. Not Ayane or Sana.
lines.zh: : 看着我。只看我。别看 Ayane 或 Sana。

lines.en: : In fact, tell those two to get out of here and I will sleep in your bed tonight. To protect you, of course.
lines.zh: : 事实上，你让那两个出去，我今晚就睡你床上。当然是为了保护你。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent19
: But Sensei doesn’t need protection. Isn’t that right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 可 Sensei 不需要保护啊。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Protection is for cowards. I know how to take care of myself.
lines.zh: : 保护是给胆小鬼的。我知道怎么照顾好自己。

lines.en: : You also know how to take care of-
lines.zh: : 你也知道怎么照顾——

lines.en: : One more word and you die.
lines.zh: : 再多说一个字你就死定了。

lines.en: : ...Flowers!
: You are an admirable gardener.
lines.zh: : 你是个令人敬佩的园丁。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent20
: Umm...are we planning on staying here much longer?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们打算在这儿待很久吗？

lines.en: : I told my mom I could work tonight and...I didn’t realize you had planned a sleepover here...
lines.zh: : 我跟妈妈说了我今晚可以去打工，而且……我不知道你们计划在这里过夜……

lines.en: : I really wish you’d tell me these things in advance...
lines.zh: : 我真希望你们能提前告诉我这些事……

lines.en: : Also...I’d...really appreciate it if...you don’t take me into boys’ rooms anymore.
lines.zh: : 还有……如果……你们别再把我带进男生的房间，我……会非常感激。

lines.en: : It smells like Sensei in here and it makes me feel funny.
lines.zh: : 这里面全是 Sensei 的味道，让我觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Right? It's magical, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 对吧？很神奇吧？

lines.en: : Doesn’t it get your heart racing, Sana?
lines.zh: : 是不是让你心跳加速了，Sana？

lines.en: : Being just inches away from where Sensei sleeps? Where he dreams?
lines.zh: : 就离 Sensei 睡觉的地方几英寸远？离他做梦的地方？

lines.en: : Can’t you feel your blood pumping?!
lines.zh: : 你感觉不到血液在沸腾吗？！

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent21
: No?
lines.zh: : 没有？

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent22
: Well, either way, be prepared to take us shopping tomorrow, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎样，明天准备好带我们去逛街吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : Like I said, I don’t need anything, but it’s not like I’m going to just turn down an opportunity to spend more time with you. Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我什么都不需要，但我也不至于会放过任何一个能和你多待一会儿的机会。哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent23
: Since Ayane doesn’t need anything, it would probably make more sense for just Sana and me to come, right?
lines.zh: : 既然 Ayane 什么都不需要，那大概只让我和 Sana 去更合理吧？

lines.en: : We can have her stay at home with her butler.
lines.zh: : 我们可以让她留在家里陪她的管家。

lines.en: : Or, better yet, how about Sana doesn’t come either and the two of us spend the entire day together?
lines.zh: : 或者，更好一点，Sana 也别来了，我们两个单独过一整天怎么样？

lines.en: : Oh! And even better than that! How about the two of us just have our {i}own{/i} Halloween party and let everyone else go to Ayane’s?
lines.zh: : 哦！还有比这更好的！干脆我们两个{i}自己{/i}办一场万圣节派对，让别人都去 Ayane 家怎么样？

lines.en: : That’s fine...but...I still need to find a costume...
lines.zh: : 那也行……可是……我还是得找到一套装扮……

lines.en: : Don’t worry Sana, you’re still coming. And so is Ayane.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Sana，你还是会去的。Ayane 也会去。

lines.en: : Ami is old enough that I think it's time she learns the value of sharing.
lines.zh: : Ami 也够大了，我想是时候让她学会分享的价值了。

lines.en: : What am I sharing exactly? Because it certainly isn’t you.
lines.zh: : 我到底在分享什么？反正肯定不是你。

lines.en: : It is me.
lines.zh: : 就是我。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent24
: I refuse.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝。

lines.en: : Love me more~
lines.zh: : 多爱我一点嘛~

lines.en: : I love you plenty enough already.
lines.zh: : 我已经够爱你了。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Sensei said he loves me.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ Sensei 说他爱我。

lines.en: : Me next! Me next! Tell me you love me too!
lines.zh: : 我也要！我也要！也跟我说你爱我！

lines.en: : It’s not fair that only Ami gets to hear it when I’m the one who brought everyone in here!
lines.zh: : 明明是我把大家带进来的，却只有 Ami 能听到，太不公平了！

lines.en: : Reward me with your affection!
lines.zh: : 用你的爱来奖励我！

lines.en: : ...I love you Ayane.
lines.zh: : ……我爱你，Ayane。

lines.en: It really makes my stomach hurt having to use the ‘L’ word twice in one day, but I might as well try and go three-for-three while I’m at it.
lines.zh: 一天之内要把那个“爱”字说两次，真的让我胃疼。不过既然都到这份上了，我不如干脆试试三投三中。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent25
: Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent26
: Ah! Sana!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sana！

lines.en: : Sensei! What do you think you’re doing?!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你以为你在干什么？！

lines.en: : I was just giving her the same treatment I gave you two.
lines.zh: : 我只是对她做了和你们两个一样的事。

lines.en: : Is she dead?
lines.zh: : 她死了吗？

lines.en: : No! Just...unconscious, I think!
lines.zh: : 没有！只是……昏过去了，我觉得！

lines.en: : Sana isn’t ready to accept your love yet! That comes much later in the story!
lines.zh: : Sana 还没准备好接受你的爱呢！那要等到故事很后面！

lines.en: : How much later? I feel like I’ve been waiting for eons.
lines.zh: : 多后面？我感觉自己已经等了好几亿年了。

lines.en: : Eons longer! Can’t you see how she’s reacting to just hearing your words?!
lines.zh: : 再等好几亿年！你没看见她光是听到你那句话就什么反应吗？！

lines.en: : I wish she’d react more like Ami. She’s handling it very well.
lines.zh: : 我真希望她能表现得像 Ami 一点。她处理得很好。

lines.en: : Hehehe~ Love love love~ My [uncle] loves me~ Ayane is stupid~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿~ 爱爱爱~ 我[uncle]爱我~ Ayane 是笨蛋~

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent27
: Well...I guess there’s no harm in letting her nap on your floor for a little while.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想让她在你地板上睡一会儿也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : Didn’t she say she had work, though?
lines.zh: : 不过她不是说要去打工吗？

lines.en: : Did she? I have an admittedly hard time focusing on anything that isn’t you while I’m in your room.
lines.zh: : 是吗？说实话，只要我在你房间里，就很难把注意力放在你以外的事情上。

lines.en: : Or in general, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 或者说，一般来说也是这样。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ve noticed that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我注意到了。

lines.en: : What should we do about Ami, though? It seems like she’s under a spell right now.
lines.zh: : 不过 Ami 该怎么办？她看起来像是中了什么咒一样。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry about that. I know how to handle this.
lines.zh: : 哦，别担心。我知道怎么处理。

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent28
: Psst...Ami...
lines.zh: : 嘘……Ami……

lines.en: : *Unintelligible whispering noises*
lines.zh: : *听不清的低语声*

lines.en: : *Even more unintelligible whispering noises*
lines.zh: : *更多听不清的低语声*

lines.en: : Ayane, what are you-
lines.zh: : Ayane，你在——

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent29
: Ah-
: Heheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Is that really true?
lines.zh: : 那是真的吗？
: ……是真的？

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent30
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Ayane, what did you say to her?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你对她说了什么？

lines.en: : A secret, obviously. Why would I have whispered if it was something it was okay for you to hear?
lines.zh: : 当然是秘密。如果是可以让你听到的话，我干嘛要耳语？

lines.en: : But...my curiosity...
lines.zh: : 可是……我很好奇……

lines.en: : You have no idea...how happy it makes me to hear that...
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道……听到那句话我有多开心……

lines.en: : Hear what? What the hell did she say to you?
lines.zh: : 听到什么？她到底跟你说了什么鬼话？

lines.en: : Just a little of this and that. It’s nothing bad. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 就是这个那个的一些小事。不是什么坏事。别担心。

lines.en: : Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ayane。

lines.en: : Sensei~
lines.zh: : Sensei~

lines.en: scene firsthalloweenevent31
: Okay, Sana! Time to get up.
lines.zh: : 好了，Sana！该起来了。

lines.en: Ayane kneels down and begins to try and shake Sana back to consciousness.
lines.zh: Ayane 跪下来，开始试着把 Sana 摇醒。

lines.en: Within a matter of minutes, she starts to come-to. While Ami, on the other hand...
lines.zh: 没过几分钟，她就开始恢复意识了。而另一边的 Ami 呢……

lines.en: Ami remains broken for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: Ami 就这样坏掉了一整晚。
